title: Frostwood Return

summary.short: Bin reaches Haven's edge and the town starts reacting to the rumor that he is alive.
summary.default: Bin reaches the Frostwood road, takes the gate route by default, and the return becomes public.

syncSummary: Rumor added: Bin was seen alive on the Frostwood road.
Hub mood set: Frostbitten shifts to uneasy relief.
Peri's follow-up can branch from the chosen return route.

completionOps.text: Bin was seen alive on the Frostwood road before dawn.

completionOps.title: Story Sync: Frostwood Return
completionOps.summary: Bin makes it back to Haven's road and the town starts reacting in public.

nodes.text: Snow folds over the Frostwood road like the world is trying to hide the paperwork. Bin lands badly, stands up worse, and hears Peri trying not to laugh.

nodes.speaker: Peri
nodes.text: Welcome home. Try not to die before anyone can be emotionally inconvenient about it.

ops.text: Story route: Bin approaches Frostbitten through the gate.
Story route: Bin hears town gossip before the reunion.

nodes.summary: Bin stays visible on purpose so the gate rumor reaches Haven first.

ops.text: Bin keeps to the gate line so his return becomes impossible to deny.

nodes.summary: Bin catches the town calling him a ghost before he can correct the rumor.

nodes.speaker: Bin
nodes.text: I am alive, mostly employed, and legally not a ghost.

nodes.speaker: Bin
nodes.text: I can explain. Badly, but with confidence.

nodes.speaker: Peri
nodes.text: Good. Stay alive long enough to help me sweep Bent Pine. If something is tailing the patrol line, I want eyes on it before the gate calms down.

nodes.summary: The return scene is recorded and Bent Pine becomes the next chapter handoff.
